tasks.recipe_text: SMB = 1/3 (SMB_B/M + SMB_OP + SMB_INV), where in each of the three 2x3 files SMB_x = mean of the 3 small portfolios - mean of the 3 big portfolios (small = SMALL Lo*, ME1 *2, SMALL Hi*; big = BIG Lo*, ME2 *2, BIG Hi*).
